channel.title: Oberlin Alumni Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Oberlin Alumni Magazine (oberlin.edu)

item.title: Bringing Data Science to Investigative Journalism | Oberlin College and Conservatory
item.description: Declan Bradley ’26 discusses his summer internship at the Howard Center for Investigative Journalism and how Oberlin’s focus on ethics in statistics prepared him for a career in computational reporting.

item.title: From Lab to Bedside: Exploring Neuroscience Research and Patient Care | Oberlin College and Conservatory
item.description: Anna Fritz ’26 studied Parkinson’s disease and shadowed specialists across multiple fields at Boston Medical Center.

item.title: How Oberlin’s CELA and STRONG Program Fuel Undergraduate Research | Oberlin College and Conservatory
item.description: Aisha Muradi ’26 explores the power of undergraduate research at Oberlin through the STRONG program, CELA, and a global Projects for Peace fellowship.

item.title: How CELA and CLEAR Empower Biochemistry Research | Oberlin College and Conservatory
item.description: Julia Ludwig ’27 highlights how Oberlin’s CELA and CLEAR programs provided the research foundation and leadership skills needed for a future in neuroscience.

item.title: Connecting Hawaiian Identity and Global Advocacy | Oberlin College and Conservatory
item.description: Isabel Handa ’26 shares how Oberlin’s Mellon Mays fellowship and CELA resources helped her bridge Hawaiian identity with global diasporic advocacy and research.

item.title: From Capitol Hill to Mellon Mays: A Journey in Engaged Scholarship | Oberlin College and Conservatory
item.description: Through CELA, Aina Tasso ’27 integrates Bonner service, Congressional internships, and Mellon Mays research to build a future in scholarship and public service.

item.title: Finding Confidence and Community Through Oberlin’s Bonner Scholars Program | Oberlin College and Conservatory
item.description: Math major Erica Vu ’26 leverages the Bonner Scholars Program and CELA resources to bridge the gap between academic research and impactful community service.

item.title: Formulating a Future: Finding a Calling in Pharmaceutical Science | Oberlin College and Conservatory
item.description: Chemistry major Alex Xie ’26 utilizes CELA’s research fellowships and scholarship advising to transition from campus labs to a future in pharmaceutical research.

item.title: Advancing AI Accessibility and Policy | Oberlin College and Conservatory
item.description: Oberlin student Tanisha Shende ’26, a Goldwater Scholar and STRONG program participant, bridges the gap between generative AI innovation, disability accessibility, and international tech policy.

item.title: Exploring Identity and Research Pathways Through CELA | Oberlin College and Conservatory
item.description: Sociology major Katelyn Liu ’26 explores Asian and Asian American identity through Oberlin’s Mellon Mays Fellowship and the Center for Engaged Liberal Arts.
